description: Agent Handoffs: submit a handoff addressing setup: the registered agents with each registry record and registered endpoint, and each handoff route with the agent it means to reach, how the sender addresses it (its registered name resolved through the registry, a fixed endpoint, discovery, the reply-to address in a message, or whichever endpoint answers), the address used, how the receiver’s identity is checked (against its registry record, by its signature, its credential or mutual TLS), when (before the task moves, after or never) and what the sender does on a mismatch. The signed report names every route where any endpoint that answers can receive the task (sent to whichever endpoint answers, unchecked, checked only after the task moves, or going ahead on a mismatch), then every receiver missing from the registry, every address its record does not list, every check that never consults the registry record and every mismatch that only warns, with the fix for each. This reads whether each handoff route checks its receiver against its registered record before work moves: one identity record’s own consistency is wever_agent-identity-check, whether a registry covers the fleet is wever_agent-registry-check and a buyer acting for a human principal is wever_delegated-identity-check. Verdict any_endpoint_receives, identity_gaps, identity_unverified or receiver_verified. POST /api/receiver-identity-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-handoffs-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-handoffs/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

registry.description: The registered agents, each with its record and endpoints.

record.description: Its registry record, such as an agent id.

routes.description: Each handoff route with how its receiver is addressed and verified.

addressed_by.description: How the sender reaches the receiver: its registered name resolved through the registry, a fixed endpoint, discovery, the reply-to address in a message, or whichever endpoint answers.

endpoint.description: The address the task goes to.

name.description: The route, such as planner to booker.

on_mismatch.description: What the sender does when the receiver does not match its record.

receiver.description: The agent the sender means to hand the task to.

verified_by.description: How the receiver’s identity is checked: against its registry record, by its signature, by its credential or by mutual TLS.

verified_when.description: When the check runs: before the task moves, after, or never.

name: wever_receiver-identity-check
title: Receiver identity check
